description: Send a preview of a saved workspace template to one email address, so the user can see it in a real inbox. It arrives from noreply@send16.com with a small 'Template test preview' banner and uses sample merge values (first name 'Test'). Only send to the user's own address unless they ask otherwise. Confirm the test address with the user first. Can be refused with 403 SENDING_PAUSED (workspace under review, nothing was sent, tell the user to contact support).

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

templateId.description: Template id from save_template or list_workspace_templates

name: send_template_test
title: Send template test
